key.name: position-mode
key.description: Where the panel is located. "auto" detects it from the panel's actual geometry (top or bottom of its monitor); "top" and "bottom" force an edge.

key.name: trigger-size
key.description: Thickness in pixels of the invisible strip at the screen edge that reveals the panel.

key.name: show-delay
key.description: Milliseconds the pointer must rest on the edge before the panel appears.

key.name: hide-delay
key.description: Milliseconds after the pointer leaves the panel before it hides again.

key.name: animation-time
key.description: Duration in milliseconds of the slide animation. 0 disables it.

key.name: toggle-peek
key.description: Pins the panel open while in fullscreen; press again to hide it.

key.name: exclude-gamemode
key.description: While Feral GameMode has at least one registered game, the panel behaves like stock GNOME in fullscreen: hidden, with no peeking.

key.name: exclude-apps
key.description: Window classes or application IDs (case-insensitive, '*' wildcard) for which a fullscreen window behaves like stock GNOME: panel hidden, no peeking.

key.name: debug
key.description: Log peek state changes to the journal.
